newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to stay up, targets 130.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to stay up, targets 130.00.

text.p: September notionnel futures on Matif will punch higher towards 130.00 despite the loss of momentum and slackening volume recently, analysts said Monday.
Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London, said while nearby 129.36 support held, the upside should continue to be favoured.

"I still favour the upside for the time being," Diebel said. "One of the most constructive things is that momentum is still declining and the market is managing to sustain these gains." By 0745 GMT, September notionnel futures were up 0.16 at 129.54.

The market's greedy performance suggested there was plenty of upside potential from here, Sneddon said. But the biggest caveat was that the volume was declining on the upmove which meant the rise might not last for much longer, he added.
But Sneddon said a test of 130.00 was still likely.
On the downside, 129.36 marked trendline support which, if broken, could trigger a fairly rapid slide to 129.04.

Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London forecast a dip to 129.06, which is near a 38.2 percent retracement of the six-day rally from June 20, before the uptrend continued. This was signalled by an "evening star" formation on candle charts.

"Given the recent strength in the contract, the pick-up in momentum and the inability to crack 128.40 support, evidence is growing for an extension higher through 129.64 to 129.86 and potentially higher," DMG said in a research note.
"Medium-term bear risk remains at 130.34 and is looking increasingly vulnerable to approach," it added.
It saw corrective declines to 128.86 -- a 61.8 percent retracement of the six-day rally -- which would hold, keeping the risk in the 128.40 region out of play.
September Pibor futures stood 0.01 higher on the day at 96.60.
